scope: Read-only CPU tensor/state comparison of accepted A R20 and A R32 checkpoint files; not a model restore or forward evaluation

method.fingerprint: Exact fingerprint FunctionDef AST extracted from bound frozen recovery.py, without importing training/controller modules
method.tensor_equality: same dtype/shape and torch.equal on contiguous uint8 views; per-tensor canonical SHA also reported
method.optimizer_equality: recursive exact type/key/scalar checks and tensor raw-byte comparisons; canonical full-state SHA cross-check

envelope.r32_direct_parent_description: H1-freeze R26, not the historical R20 checkpoint

conclusion: Between the accepted R20 and R32 endpoints, all saved Tokenizer/base-codebook/Mixer/item-slot/hard-SID tensors and the entire T optimizer state are exactly unchanged, while the recommender state (including its SID embedding) and R optimizer advanced. This supports continued recommender optimization with fixed encoding over this continuation.
limits: Endpoint saved-state comparison; it does not independently replay every intervening update.
No model instantiation, load_state_dict, optimizer restoration, training, forward pass, or newly computed effective crossed_codebooks.
initial_codebooks and _recommender_codebook_cache are persistent=False and absent from checkpoint state_dict; asset/config/source bindings agree, but unsaved transient cache values were not compared.
Unchanged deterministic encoding function, its saved inputs/parameters, and hard_codes are verified; no claim of newly executing deterministic re-encoding.
This is not final real model-restore acceptance, bitwise full-trajectory replay, causal proof for temporal metric changes, or Goal completion.
